message.content: {"skills":[{"name":"Incident Capacity Reduction Enforcement","description":"Computes an edge's effective MaxVehicles under an active incident's CapacityMultiplier and enforces that limit during the Capacity & Conflict Check Phase, denying ENTER_EDGE requests that would exceed it. Use when an incident reduces edge capacity and a vehicle requests entry.","prompt":"During the Capacity & Conflict Check Phase, for an edge with an active incident specifying a CapacityMultiplier: (1) take the edge's baseline MaxVehicles (LaneCount × CapacityPerLane); (2) compute effective MaxVehicles = floor(baseline × CapacityMultiplier); (3) when a vehicle requests ENTER_EDGE, approve only if current occupancy plus the new vehicle does not exceed effective MaxVehicles; otherwise deny the request and have the vehicle perform WAIT at its current node for that tick.","asset_type":"micro_skill","asset_node_id":"micro_skill_node","granularity":"micro","objective":"Compute effective edge capacity under an incident and deny entry requests that would exceed it.","domain":"traffic simulation rules","task_family":"capacity enforcement","method_family":"capacity computation and admission control","stage":"capacity & conflict check phase","applicable_signals":["Active incident with CapacityMultiplier on the target edge","ENTER_EDGE request targeting an edge with reduced capacity","Current occupancy at or near effective MaxVehicles"],"intervention_moves":["Derive baseline MaxVehicles from LaneCount and CapacityPerLane","Apply floor(baseline × CapacityMultiplier) to get effective MaxVehicles","Compare current occupancy plus requested vehicle against effective MaxVehicles","Deny over-capacity ENTER_EDGE and substitute WAIT at current node"],"contraindications":["No incident is active on the edge","The request is not an edge-entry request"],"triggers":["An active incident specifies a CapacityMultiplier on an edge","A vehicle requests ENTER_EDGE on an edge with reduced capacity"],"workflow_steps":["Identify the active incident and its CapacityMultiplier on the target edge.","Compute baseline MaxVehicles = LaneCount × CapacityPerLane.","Compute effective MaxVehicles = floor(baseline × CapacityMultiplier).","On an ENTER_EDGE request, check whether occupancy plus the new vehicle exceeds effective MaxVehicles.","If it would exceed, deny the request and have the vehicle WAIT at its current node for that tick; otherwise approve."],"constraints":["Apply the floor function to the capacity product.","Enforce the limit only during the Capacity & Conflict Check Phase.","Denied vehicles must WAIT at their current node for that tick."],"cautions":["Do not apply the multiplier when no incident is active on the edge.","Do not approve entry that would push occupancy above effective MaxVehicles."],"output_contract":["Effective MaxVehicles computed and over-capacity ENTER_EDGE requests denied, with denied vehicles performing WAIT at their current node."],"examples":[{"input":"Incident I1 on an edge with LaneCount = 2, CapacityPerLane = 2, CapacityMultiplier = 0.5; at a tick, 2 vehicles already on the edge and a third requests ENTER_EDGE.","output":"Baseline MaxVehicles = 4; effective MaxVehicles = floor(4 × 0.5) = 2; request denied; vehicle performs WAIT at its current node for that tick.","notes":"Illustrates incident-driven capacity math and admission denial."}],"tags":["capacity","incident","admission-control","edge-entry","traffic-simulation"],"confidence":0.8,"risk_class":"low","support_ids":["c3ce014d-de28-521a-b852-a5b0a436c016"],"source_draft_ids":["263353b0-5b95-5206-a41f-2af173cdfe5e"]}]}
